Name: Dog Skins - Modify Your Dog
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][color=#ff7700][font=Georgia][size=6][b][u]Dogs Variety[/u][/b][/size][/font][/color][/center][font=Georgia]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=5][u][i]Other Variety Family Mods:[/i][/u][/size][/color][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10574][size=4]Cats Variety
[/size][/url][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14030]Horses Variety[/url][/size][size=4]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8914]Mines Variety
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8890]Monsters Variety[/url][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14187/][size=4]Nature Variety[/size][/url]



[size=4]This mod allows you to change the appearance of your dog, eyes color, and put a collar and change its color.
It's not much of a mystery and you can configure it so that each day has a different color collar.
Without much more to add, I hope you enjoy it![/size]

Dogs don't have eyes...

[i][b][size=5][color=#ff0000]The mod has several options, designed for mods that allow you to have more than one dog in your farm, if you do not have this type of mods, [/color][color=#ffff00][u]only modifies the first variant[/u].[/color][/size][/b]
[/i]
[size=6][color=#ffff00][b]
[i][u]Mod Options:[/u][/i][/b][/color][color=#ff7700] 
[/color][/size][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]I recommend using the Mod: "[/b][/size][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]". To read what each option does from this menu[/b][/size][/color][size=6]
[/size]
[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]Some options have the variable "Random" which allows you to change the object placed on your dog automatically every day.
[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]

Downloads.Description:
REMOVE ANY PREVIOUS VERSION BEFORE INSTALLING THIS NEW VERSION
Unzip and move to the mods folder of the game. I recommend using Generic Mod Menu to configure the mod.
